{
 "note_id": 2995,
 "title": "Food Recipes",
 "content": "# Food Recipes

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
favorite: false

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh thyme leaves, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 400\xB0F (200\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- In a bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, whole grain mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Brush the glaze over the fillets.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with fresh thyme leaves before serving.
favorite: true

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients:
- 200g spaghetti
- 100g pancetta or guanciale, diced
- 2 large eggs
- 50g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain and set aside.
- In a skillet, cook the diced pancetta or guanciale until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
- In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, grated Pecorino Romano cheese, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Combine the cooked spaghetti with the egg mixture and pancetta. Toss until the pasta is coated and creamy.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and additional grated cheese. Serve immediately.
favorite: true",

  "cooking"

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."

- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh thyme leaves, for garnish

- "Preheat the oven to 400\xB0F (200\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."

 "content": "# Food Recipes

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
favorite: false

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh thyme leaves, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 400\xB0F (200\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- In a bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, whole grain mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Brush the glaze over the fillets.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with fresh thyme leaves before serving.
favorite: true

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients:
- 200g spaghetti
- 100g pancetta or guanciale, diced
- 2 large eggs
- 50g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain and set aside.
- In a skillet, cook the diced pancetta or guanciale until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
- In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, grated Pecorino Romano cheese, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Combine the cooked spaghetti with the egg mixture and pancetta. Toss until the pasta is coated and creamy.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and additional grated cheese. Serve immediately.

 "note_id": 2994,
 "title": "Weekly Workout Plan",
 "content": "# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90",

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
favorite: false

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh thyme leaves, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 400\xB0F (200\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- In a bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, whole grain mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Brush the glaze over the fillets.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with fresh thyme leaves before serving.
favorite: true

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients:
- 200g spaghetti
- 100g pancetta or guanciale, diced
- 2 large eggs
- 50g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 cloves garlic, minced

- In a skillet, cook the diced pancetta or guanciale until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.

- Combine the cooked spaghetti with the egg mixture and pancetta. Toss until the pasta is coated and creamy.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and additional grated cheese. Serve immediately.

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
favorite: false

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh thyme leaves, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 400\xB0F (200\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- In a bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, whole grain mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Brush the glaze over the fillets.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with fresh thyme leaves before serving.
favorite: true

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients:
- 200g spaghetti
- 100g pancetta or guanciale, diced
- 2 large eggs
- 50g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain and set aside.
- In a skillet, cook the diced pancetta or guanciale until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
- In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, grated Pecorino Romano cheese, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Combine the cooked spaghetti with the egg mixture and pancetta. Toss until the pasta is coated and creamy.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and additional grated cheese. Serve immediately.

{
 "note_id": 2995,
 "title": "Food Recipes",
 "content": "# Food Recipes

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed

- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced

- 1 tablespoon brown sugar

instructions:

- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced

- 2 cloves garlic, minced

- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:

- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.

- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
favorite: false

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh thyme leaves, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 400\xB0F (200\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- In a bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, whole grain mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Brush the glaze over the fillets.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with fresh thyme leaves before serving.
favorite: true

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients:
- 200g spaghetti
- 100g pancetta or guanciale, diced
- 2 large eggs
- 50g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:

- In a skillet, cook the diced pancetta or guanciale until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
- In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, grated Pecorino Romano cheese, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Combine the cooked spaghetti with the egg mixture and pancetta. Toss until the pasta is coated and creamy.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and additional grated cheese. Serve immediately.

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
favorite: false

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh thyme leaves, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 400\xB0F (200\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- In a bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, whole grain mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Brush the glaze over the fillets.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with fresh thyme leaves before serving.
favorite: true

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients:
- 200g spaghetti
- 100g pancetta or guanciale, diced
- 2 large eggs
- 50g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain and set aside.
- In a skillet, cook the diced pancetta or guanciale until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
- In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, grated Pecorino Romano cheese, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Combine the cooked spaghetti with the egg mixture and pancetta. Toss until the pasta is coated and creamy.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and additional grated cheese. Serve immediately.

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
favorite: false

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh thyme leaves, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 400\xB0F (200\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- In a bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, whole grain mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Brush the glaze over the fillets.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with fresh thyme leaves before serving.

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients:
- 200g spaghetti
- 100g pancetta or guanciale, diced
- 2 large eggs
- 50g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:

- In a skillet, cook the diced pancetta or guanciale until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.

- Combine the cooked spaghetti with the egg mixture and pancetta. Toss until the pasta is coated and creamy.

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:

- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:

- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste

instructions:

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients:
- 200g spaghetti
- 100g pancetta or guanciale, diced
- 2 large eggs
- 50g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 cloves garlic, minced

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
favorite: false

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh thyme leaves, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 400\xB0F (200\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- In a bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, whole grain mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Brush the glaze over the fillets.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with fresh thyme leaves before serving.
favorite: true

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients:
- 200g spaghetti
- 100g pancetta or guanciale, diced
- 2 large eggs
- 50g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:

- In a skillet, cook the diced pancetta or guanciale until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
- In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, grated Pecorino Romano cheese, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Combine the cooked spaghetti with the egg mixture and pancetta. Toss until the pasta is coated and creamy.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and additional grated cheese. Serve immediately.

 "content": "# Food Recipes

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
favorite: false

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh thyme leaves, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 400\xB0F (200\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- In a bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, whole grain mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Brush the glaze over the fillets.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with fresh thyme leaves before serving.
favorite: true

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients:
- 200g spaghetti
- 100g pancetta or guanciale, diced
- 2 large eggs
- 50g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain and set aside.
- In a skillet, cook the diced pancetta or guanciale until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
- In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, grated Pecorino Romano cheese, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Combine the cooked spaghetti with the egg mixture and pancetta. Toss until the pasta is coated and creamy.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and additional grated cheese. Serve immediately.

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:

- 1 green bell pepper, sliced

- 1 tablespoon brown sugar

instructions:

- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.

ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets

- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:

- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.

- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:

- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.

- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.

 "content": "# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:

ingredients:

- 2 lemons, sliced

- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:

- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.

- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.

ingredients:

- Salt and black pepper to taste

 "content": "# Food Recipes

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
favorite: false

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh thyme leaves, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 400\xB0F (200\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- In a bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, whole grain mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Brush the glaze over the fillets.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with fresh thyme leaves before serving.
favorite: true

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients:
- 200g spaghetti
- 100g pancetta or guanciale, diced
- 2 large eggs
- 50g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain and set aside.
- In a skillet, cook the diced pancetta or guanciale until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
- In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, grated Pecorino Romano cheese, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Combine the cooked spaghetti with the egg mixture and pancetta. Toss until the pasta is coated and creamy.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and additional grated cheese. Serve immediately.

{
 "note_id": 2995,
 "title": "Food Recipes",
 "content": "# Food Recipes

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
favorite: false

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh thyme leaves, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 400\xB0F (200\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- In a bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, whole grain mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Brush the glaze over the fillets.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with fresh thyme leaves before serving.
favorite: true

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients:
- 200g spaghetti
- 100g pancetta or guanciale, diced
- 2 large eggs
- 50g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:

- In a skillet, cook the diced pancetta or guanciale until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
- In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, grated Pecorino Romano cheese, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Combine the cooked spaghetti with the egg mixture and pancetta. Toss until the pasta is coated and creamy.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and additional grated cheese. Serve immediately.

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
favorite: false

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh thyme leaves, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 400\xB0F (200\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- In a bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, whole grain mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Brush the glaze over the fillets.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with fresh thyme leaves before serving.
favorite: true

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients:
- 200g spaghetti
- 100g pancetta or guanciale, diced
- 2 large eggs
- 50g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain and set aside.
- In a skillet, cook the diced pancetta or guanciale until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
- In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, grated Pecorino Romano cheese, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Combine the cooked spaghetti with the egg mixture and pancetta. Toss until the pasta is coated and creamy.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and additional grated cheese. Serve immediately.

{
 "note_id": 2995,
 "title": "Food Recipes",
 "content": "# Food Recipes

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
favorite: false

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard

                # Create a dictionary to store the expense information

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:

- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
favorite: false

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh thyme leaves, for garnish
instructions:

- In a bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, whole grain mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Brush the glaze over the fillets.

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 can (400ml) coconut milk
- 2 tablespoons red curry paste
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 green bell pepper, sliced
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- Fresh basil leaves, for garnish
- Cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions:
- "In a wok or skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and saut\xE9 for a minute."
- Add red curry paste and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.
- Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
- Add the sliced vegetables and tofu cubes. Cook until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is heated through.
- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.
- Serve the curry over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with fresh basil leaves.
favorite: false

name: Baked Lemon Herb Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 2 lemons, sliced
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 375\xB0F (190\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:
- In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a simmer.
- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
favorite: false

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Salmon
ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- 1/4 cup Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh thyme leaves, for garnish
instructions:
- "Preheat the oven to 400\xB0F (200\xB0C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper."
- In a bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, whole grain mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Brush the glaze over the fillets.
- Bake in the preheated oven for about 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with fresh thyme leaves before serving.
favorite: true

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients:
- 200g spaghetti
- 100g pancetta or guanciale, diced
- 2 large eggs
- 50g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:

- In a skillet, cook the diced pancetta or guanciale until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
- In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, grated Pecorino Romano cheese, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
- Combine the cooked spaghetti with the egg mixture and pancetta. Toss until the pasta is coated and creamy.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and additional grated cheese. Serve immediately.

name: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
ingredients:

- 1 green bell pepper, sliced

- Stir in soy sauce and brown sugar.

ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets

- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish
instructions:

- Place the salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with minced garlic, dried thyme, dried rosemary, salt, and black pepper.

- Bake in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.
favorite: true

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
- 8 cups chicken broth
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
- 100g egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions:

- Add the chicken breasts, carrots, celery, onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
- Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
- Remove the chicken breasts from the pot and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the pot.
- Add the egg noodles and cook until tender, following the package instructions.
- Season the soup with salt and black pepper to taste.
- Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
